sourceEvidence.claim: The shared-signature intro + FA's vowels gloss (verification-only)
sourceEvidence.quote:
Signs and symptoms of all hepatitis viruses: episodes of fever, jaundice, ↑ ALT and AST. NAkEd viruses (HAV
and HEV) lack an envelope and are not destroyed by the gut: the vowels hit your bowels.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: The HBV polymerase mechanism (DNA- and RNA-dependent; completes partial dsDNA; reverse transcription)
sourceEvidence.quote:
HBV DNA polymerase has DNA- and RNA-dependent activities. Upon entry into nucleus, the polymerase
completes the partial dsDNA. Host RNA polymerase transcribes mRNA from viral DNA to make viral
proteins. The DNA polymerase then reverse transcribes viral RNA to DNA.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: The HCV escape mechanism (no 3'-5' exonuclease; no proofreading; antigenic variation; antibody lags)
sourceEvidence.quote:
HCV lacks 3′-5′ exonuclease activity →  no proofreading ability →  antigenic variation of HCV envelope
proteins. Host antibody production lags behind production of new mutant strains of HCV.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the table and markers; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The enteric-vs-parenteral axis wired to M22's envelope and complementation logic (HDV's HBsAg coat); the pregnancy exception (HEV fulminant); the serology clock with the window-period gap and the immunized-alone pattern; the B-vs-C extrahepatic split by system; and the chronicity mechanism (HCV's missing proofreading) — labeled as integrations.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the table, markers, and patterns without the axis synthesis or the clock logic; these are KYP's design.

notes: Census: p192 1 raster (the Councilman-bodies histology A); p193 17 tiny sep rasters (the patterns table's +/- marks — redrawn as text marks in the visual; the timeline itself is vector). The source's own column-header typos print on book 170: 'INCUCATION' (line 51) and 'LIVER CIOPSY' (line 121) — both carried verbatim in the note's table with the typo marked. The 5-virus table columns emit in grouped blocks; the HDV and HEV notes interleave at the page end; p193's timeline labels emit in two passes (curve labels before the axis numbers, pattern labels after); the (IgM)/(IgG) qualifiers attach to the pattern names. FA's printed gloss ('the vowels hit your bowels') is quoted in the table block for verification only.
